name: standard
description: The published methodology. A run is STANDARD only when these values are used unchanged.

name: quick
description: 2-minute local loop. Drops the slow packs and the cap and timeout probes. Always CUSTOM.

name: ci
description: Standard checks with a log summary and JUnit and JSON files, no kept sandbox (the default A gate applies).

name: strict
description: Standard with the advisory checks counted in the score. CUSTOM (stricter is still non-standard).

name: paranoid
description: Strict plus the exec pack and DNS probes. exec still needs --active on the command line. CUSTOM.
